page.overview:
Who is Maralenda?

Maralenda is an Andoran Aes Sedai of noble origin, in the rebel camp near Tar Valon. Therefore, she is not of the Red Ajah.

She is a distant cousin to the House Trakand and Siuan uses the fact that she had been seen talking to Romanda to distract Lelaine and trying to manipulate her.
